title: The knip.json `ignoreDependencies: ["jscpd"]` suppression is legitimate and wel…
description:
The knip.json `ignoreDependencies: ["jscpd"]` suppression is legitimate and well-justified in patterns.md (jscpd is a CLI-only tool invoked via a bunx shell-string that knip cannot detect statically; knip special-cases its own package name so no entry is needed for knip). Consider a one-line inline comment or JSON note near the entry so a future editor does not have to cross-reference patterns.md to understand why it is not dead-config.
